options.text: Yes, I'm sure I can get some Jubbly Chompy.
Oh Ok then, I guess I'll talk to Rantz.

blocks.html: Head to Feldip Hills AKS and talk to Rantz to the north-east.
blocks.text: Head to Feldip Hills AKS and talk to Rantz to the north-east.

options.text: I'm trying to free Skrach. Can you help?

blocks.html: Follow the coast south and talk to Rantz.
blocks.text: Follow the coast south and talk to Rantz.

options.text: I guess this is the watery place. What now?

blocks.html: Cut the roots of the old tree, carve it
blocks.text: Cut the roots of the old tree, carve it

options.text: Okay, the boat's ready; now tell me how to get a jubbly.

blocks.html: With a raw chompy, iron spit, and logs, teleport to the Karamja lodestone.
blocks.text: With a raw chompy, iron spit, and logs, teleport to the Karamja lodestone.

blocks.html: Head south until a row boat is seen along the western coast. Just south-east of the boat is a small tree with Rantz's arrow stuck in it.
blocks.text: Head south until a row boat is seen along the western coast. Just south-east of the boat is a small tree with Rantz's arrow stuck in it.

blocks.html: Use the iron spit on the raw chompy and light a fire just west of the small tree.
blocks.text: Use the iron spit on the raw chompy and light a fire just west of the small tree.

blocks.html: Cook the chompy on the fire.
blocks.text: Cook the chompy on the fire.

options.text: Yes please, I'll get a lift back with you.
Okay, now tell me how to get jubbly.

blocks.html: Make a balloon toad by using the following steps (it is advised to make a few in the event you burn the raw jubbly).
blocks.text: Make a balloon toad by using the following steps (it is advised to make a few in the event you burn the raw jubbly).

substeps.html: Just west, fill your ogre bellows with swamp bubbles from the swamp, then use the bellows on a swamp toad.
substeps.text: Just west, fill your ogre bellows with swamp bubbles from the swamp, then use the bellows on a swamp toad.

substeps.html: Directly west or north-west of the swamp pool, mine a feldip swamp rock (near AKS).
substeps.text: Directly west or north-west of the swamp pool, mine a feldip swamp rock (near AKS).

substeps.html: With the rock, toad, and a ball of wool in your inventory, use the bellows on the bloated toad again to make a balloon toad (the bellows must be filled).
substeps.text: With the rock, toad, and a ball of wool in your inventory, use the bellows on the bloated toad again to make a balloon toad (the bellows must be filled).

blocks.html: Drop the balloon toad in the area where Rantz is.
blocks.text: Drop the balloon toad in the area where Rantz is.

blocks.html: When a jubbly bird appears, kill it with an ogre bow and pluck it.
blocks.text: When a jubbly bird appears, kill it with an ogre bow and pluck it.

substeps.html: If a jubbly bird does not spawn by the time the balloon toad disappears, you will need to make another one.
substeps.text: If a jubbly bird does not spawn by the time the balloon toad disappears, you will need to make another one.

blocks.html: Head north to the ogre spit-roast fire and cook the raw jubbly. If you burn it, you must repeat the hunting process.
blocks.text: Head north to the ogre spit-roast fire and cook the raw jubbly. If you burn it, you must repeat the hunting process.

blocks.html: Return to Lumbridge Castle and Use cooked jubbly on Skrach.
blocks.text: Return to Lumbridge Castle and Use cooked jubbly on Skrach.
